content:
maria.garcia: Quick Q — Acme's invoice for the prepaid support + license bundle came in for $120,000 but the PDF breaks it out as $90k license / $30k support. Do we defer the full $120k or only the support portion?

sam.kim: We generally recognize license upfront and defer support over the term. Confirm the contract term for the support credits.

lisa.revrec: Contract says 12 months of support credits starting 2026-02-01. So $30k deferred, $2,500/month. License $90k recognized on delivery (shipment/activation).

maria.garcia: The invoice hit GL 4000 (Revenue) for full $120k by mistake. Devin, can you reverse and move support to 2190 (Deferred Revenue)?

devin.billing: Seen. I can reclass tomorrow morning but need the invoice number and PO. Also any journal memo text we should attach?

maria.garcia: Invoice INV-2026-0042, PO 4501. Memo: "Move prepaid support portion to deferred revenue per contract 2345."

lisa.revrec: Can we also create a revenue schedule so recognition posts automatically every month? Prefer journal templates instead of manual.

devin.billing: Yep — will create a recurring recognition journal. Plan: Credit 2190 (deferred) to Debit 4003 (service rev) monthly for $2,500. One-off recognition for license stays in 4000.

sam.kim: Double-check salesforce invoice mapping — SF shows product code ACME-LIC for whole amount. We need Sales ops to update the line items so downstream billing sends correct GL next time. @sales-ops FYI.

maria.garcia: Copy that. Also flagging for month-end — will we need an accrual adjustment if recognition periods cross periods? Example: term starts 2/1, close date 1/31 cutoff might need a pro rata.

lisa.revrec: Yes, for Jan close we should book a deffered revenue liability on 1/31 for the entire $30k since support hasn't started. No accrual to revenue yet.

devin.billing: Will prepare two JEs tomorrow: 1) Reclass invoice amount $30,000 Dr 4000 Cr 2190 with invoice memo; 2) Set up recurring monthly recognition entries starting 2026-02-28 Dr 2190 Cr 4003 $2,500.

maria.garcia: Thanks. Can you put the draft JE in Close Checklist (Drive link) and ping me when done?

close-bot: Reminder — month-end checklist item #12: Deferred revenue journal entries due by 16:00 PST on 2026-02-02.

devin.billing: Will upload draft and tag you. Also adding the invoice PDF and contract clause to the JE.

maria.garcia: Perfect — that'll resolve the misposted revenue for Jan close. One more: do we need to notify auditors?

lisa.revrec: I'll note in the close memo and include the corrected JE and contract. No separate audit trigger for this routine deferral, but auditors will review as part of standard close docs.

sam.kim: Thanks team. Action items: Devin reclass + create schedule, Lisa add close memo, Maria confirm sales ops update mapping.

maria.garcia: On it. :thumbsup:
